command.cmd: $s2bDocBlocks = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\tmp\2B\S2B-T06\rv1\review\f02\document_blocks.json', [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json; $s2bParseRows=@(); foreach ($s2bDocBlock in $s2bDocBlocks) { if ($s2bDocBlock.language -eq 'powershell') { $s2bTokens=$null; $s2bParseErrors=$null; $null=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput([string]$s2bDocBlock.source,[ref]$s2bTokens,[ref]$s2bParseErrors); $s2bParseRows += @{index=$s2bDocBlock.index;language=$s2bDocBlock.language;errors=@($s2bParseErrors | ForEach-Object {$_.Message})} } }; @{status='PASS_SYNTAX_ONLY';powershell_blocks=$s2bParseRows.Count;hardware_commands_executed=$false;results=$s2bParseRows} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; if ($s2bParseRows.Count -ne 4 -or @($s2bParseRows | Where-Object { $_.errors.Count -ne 0 }).Count -ne 0) { exit 1 }
